name: MassHealth Anti-Obesity Agents — Tirzepatide (Zepbound) PA Criteria

branches.initial: Initial prior authorization for tirzepatide-Zepbound for obesity, overweight, or moderate-severe OSA with obesity
branches.recertification: Renewal of approved Zepbound therapy (separate criteria — not modeled in this version)

criteria.description: Medical necessity criteria for tirzepatide-Zepbound: eligibility AND baseline documentation AND (conditional Mounjaro comparison) AND phentermine step-therapy satisfaction AND BMI-based indication.

policy_citation.quote: Documentation of the following is required for obesity, overweight, or moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) with obesity

children.description: Patient eligibility (age and qualifying diagnosis).
Member is 18 years of age or older.

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute age from Patient.birthDate at the date of the PA request.

verdict_rubric.met: Member's age at request date is ≥18 years.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Member's age at request date is <18 years (Zepbound branch does not apply; Wegovy pediatric branch may).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient.birthDate present but request date ambiguous.

children.description: Appropriate diagnosis: obesity (E66.0*/E66.9), overweight (E66.3), or moderate-severe OSA with obesity (G47.33 plus obesity).

policy_citation.quote: Documentation of the following is required for obesity, overweight, or moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) with obesity

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for ICD-10 E66.0*, E66.9, E66.3, or G47.33 (moderate-to-severe OSA) accompanied by an obesity code. BMI Z68.3*/Z68.4* may also indicate obesity range.

verdict_rubric.met: Qualifying ICD-10 diagnosis present on the problem list or visit diagnosis.
verdict_rubric.not_met: No qualifying diagnosis; only off-label indications listed (e.g., insulin resistance alone).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Narrative mentions 'weight loss' without coded diagnosis.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No diagnosis fields in available records.

children.description: Required baseline documentation items.
Member weight documented and dated within 90 days prior to initiation of pharmacotherapy for obesity.

policy_citation.quote: member weight (dated within the 90 days prior to initiation of pharmacotherapy for obesity

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find Observation with LOINC 29463-7 (body weight) or 39156-5 (BMI). Date must be within 90 days of the request date. The weight does NOT have to be measured for the requested agent specifically.

verdict_rubric.met: Weight Observation with date within 90 days of request.

children.description: Member has been counseled to continue a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

policy_citation.quote: member has been counseled to continue reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for explicit counseling notes referencing diet AND physical activity. Counseling is typically documented in the assessment/plan section of an office visit.

verdict_rubric.met: Plan/assessment explicitly documents counseling on both reduced-calorie diet and increased activity.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Counseling mentioned for one (e.g., diet) but not both.

children.description: Requested quantity is ≤ four pens per 28 days.

policy_citation.quote: requested quantity is ≤ four pens/28 days

evaluation.extraction_hints: Inspect MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.quantity (count per 28 days). Convert if expressed differently (e.g., 1 pen/week = 4 pens/28 days).

verdict_rubric.met: Requested quantity is ≤4 pens per 28 days.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Requested quantity exceeds 4 pens per 28 days.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Quantity expressed in non-standard units; conversion ambiguous.

children.description: Requested agent will not be used in combination with another GLP-1 receptor agonist.

policy_citation.quote: requested agent will not be used in combination with another GLP-1 receptor agonist

evaluation.extraction_hints: Scan active medication list for other GLP-1/GIP agonists: semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus), liraglutide (Victoza, Saxenda), dulaglutide (Trulicity), exenatide (Byetta, Bydureon), tirzepatide (Mounjaro). Active concurrent use is disqualifying.

verdict_rubric.met: No other GLP-1 agonist in active medication list.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Another GLP-1 agonist is documented as active concurrent use.
verdict_rubric.unclear: GLP-1 agonist on med list but status (active vs. discontinued) ambiguous.

children.description: Conditional: if member has T2DM or prediabetes, documentation of medical necessity for Zepbound instead of Mounjaro is required.

policy_citation.quote: for members with a comorbid condition of type 2 diabetes mellitus or prediabetes, medical necessity for use of the requested agent instead of Mounjaro

evaluation.extraction_hints: If Condition list contains E11.* (T2DM) or R73.* (prediabetes), look for an explicit clinician narrative justifying Zepbound over Mounjaro. If no T2DM/prediabetes documented, this criterion is automatically met (conditional applicability).

verdict_rubric.met: No T2DM/prediabetes on problem list (criterion not applicable); OR T2DM/prediabetes present AND clinician documented medical necessity for Zepbound over Mounjaro.
verdict_rubric.not_met: T2DM/prediabetes documented but no medical-necessity rationale provided for choosing Zepbound over Mounjaro.
verdict_rubric.unclear: T2DM/prediabetes present; rationale narrative present but vague or generic.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: T2DM/prediabetes present but no notes addressing agent choice.

children.description: Phentermine step-therapy requirement: ONE of (inadequate response after adequate trial) OR (documented adverse reaction) OR (documented contraindication).

policy_citation.quote: inadequate response to phentermine with or without topiramate

children.description: Inadequate response to phentermine: ALL of adherence, response-inadequacy, and BMI ≥27.
Member is adherent to phentermine, defined as ≥ 90 of the last 120 days covered by pharmacy claims or equivalent documentation.

policy_citation.quote: member is adherent to phentermine (defined as ≥ 90 out of the last 120 days)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute days-of-supply coverage from pharmacy claims for phentermine in the 120-day window prior to the Zepbound request. Adherence threshold: ≥90 days covered.

verdict_rubric.met: Pharmacy claims show ≥90 days covered out of the last 120 days.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pharmacy claims show <90 days covered out of the last 120 days.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Phentermine documented but pharmacy claims dates incomplete.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No phentermine fills or claims found.

children.description: Inadequate clinical response: either insufficient (<5% reduction at 3+ months) OR plateau (no weight loss for 3+ months).
Insufficient response: <5% reduction in body weight from baseline despite ≥3 months at maximally tolerated dose.

policy_citation.quote: insufficient clinical response defined as < 5% reduction in body weight from baseline despite initial trial of ≥ three months of treatment with the maximally tolerated dose of phentermine

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute (baseline_weight - current_weight)/baseline_weight × 100. Trigger if <5% AND at least 3 months at max-tolerated dose.

verdict_rubric.met: <5% reduction documented after ≥3 months at max-tolerated dose.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Reduction documented but trial duration <3 months OR baseline weight unknown.

children.description: Plateaued response: no weight loss for at least 3 months at maximally tolerated dose of phentermine.

policy_citation.quote: plateaued clinical response defined as no weight loss for at least

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for a stretch of ≥3 months at max-tolerated dose during which serial weights show no net loss (within measurement noise of ±1 kg). Continuation from earlier loss followed by 3-month flat is sufficient.

verdict_rubric.met: Serial weights show ≥3 months of no net loss at max-tolerated dose.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Weight continues to decrease, or insufficient time at dose.

children.description: Member's current BMI is ≥ 27 kg/m², dated within 90 days prior to treatment initiation of requested agent.

evaluation.extraction_hints: BMI Observation (LOINC 39156-5) dated within 90 days of request, value ≥27. Use latest qualifying value.

children.description: Medical records document an adverse reaction to phentermine that is allergic in nature or cannot be expected/managed as part of weight-loss therapy.

policy_citation.quote: medical records documenting adverse reaction to phentermine that is allergic in nature or cannot be expected or managed as part of weight loss therapy

evaluation.extraction_hints: AllergyIntolerance with substance phentermine, or AdverseEvent referencing phentermine, or narrative documenting a reaction that wasn't a manageable side-effect.

verdict_rubric.met: Explicit allergic or non-tolerable reaction to phentermine documented.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Side effects documented but routine and manageable (e.g., transient dry mouth, mild insomnia).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient self-discontinued without explicit AE classification.

children.description: Medical records document a contraindication to phentermine.

policy_citation.quote: medical records documenting contraindication to phentermine

evaluation.extraction_hints: Acceptable contraindications include (per MassHealth phentermine policy): arrhythmia, CAD, CHF, MI history, stroke history, uncontrolled HTN, hyperthyroidism, glaucoma, history of psychosis, bipolar with mania, MAOI concomitant use, pregnancy/lactation, severe renal disease, SUD/OUD/AUD/SUD.

verdict_rubric.met: Member has a documented condition from the acceptable phentermine-contraindication list.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Member has none of the listed contraindications.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Condition documented but mapping to contraindication list ambiguous (e.g., 'mild HTN').

children.description: BMI-based qualification: either BMI ≥30 alone, OR BMI ≥27 plus a weight-related comorbidity.
Member BMI is ≥ 30 kg/m², dated within 90 days prior to initiation.

evaluation.extraction_hints: BMI Observation (LOINC 39156-5) ≥30 dated within 90 days. Does not have to be measured for the requested agent.

verdict_rubric.not_met: Recent BMI <30 (member would need to qualify via BMI≥27 + comorbidity path).
verdict_rubric.unclear: BMI value present but date unclear.

children.description: BMI ≥ 27 kg/m² PLUS at least one weight-related comorbid condition.
Member BMI is ≥ 27 kg/m², dated within 90 days prior to initiation.

At least one of the listed weight-related comorbid conditions present: coronary heart disease or other atherosclerotic disease, dyslipidemia, hypertension, NASH, obstructive sleep apnea, polycystic ovarian syndrome, prediabetes, systemic osteoarthritis, or type 2 diabetes mellitus.

policy_citation.quote: one of the following weight-related comorbid conditions

evaluation.extraction_hints: Map ICD-10 codes: CHD/atherosclerosis I20-I25; dyslipidemia E78.*; HTN I10-I11; NASH K75.81; OSA G47.33; PCOS E28.2; prediabetes R73.0*; osteoarthritis M15-M19; T2DM E11.*.

verdict_rubric.met: At least one qualifying comorbidity present.
verdict_rubric.not_met: No qualifying comorbidity in problem list.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Comorbidity mentioned in narrative but not coded; mapping ambiguous.

exclusions.description: Concurrent use of another GLP-1 receptor agonist (covered as a leaf requirement; surfaced separately as an exclusion for short-circuit denial).

policy_citation.quote: requested agent will not be used in combination with another GLP-1 receptor agonist

evaluation.extraction_hints: If active GLP-1 prescription (semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, exenatide, tirzepatide-Mounjaro) is present concurrently, exclusion fires.

verdict_rubric.met: Active concurrent GLP-1 documented — exclusion fires (deny).

metadata.notes: Models the Zepbound-for-obesity branch of MassHealth Anti-Obesity Agents policy. Wegovy pediatric, Wegovy cardiovascular, and Wegovy NASH branches are intentionally out of scope for this version and would be modeled as sibling policies or branches.
scope_cuts: Wegovy pediatric branch (12 to <18, BMI 95th percentile)
Wegovy cardiovascular branch (CV protection in established CVD, no DM)
Wegovy NASH branch (liver biopsy or NIT, GE/hepatology prescriber)
